target: towards: base of corolla tube (FLOPO_0985018 corolla tube, base part)
fix: In 'adnate to base of <part>' the target is the named part (or its base), not a generic 'plant organ base'; keep the 'of <part>' head when resolving the target.
reason: The stamens are adnate to the base of the corolla tube. The target became a generic organ base (FLOPO_0985024), which loses which organ they are fused to.
'callose-mucronate at the apex' of the leaf blade: leaf apex mucronate is right. The callose part is dropped, but nothing false is said.

fix: '<colour1> striated/striped with <colour2>': colour1 is the ground colour of the part; colour2 is only the colour of the stripes (pattern = striped). Do not assign colour2 to the whole part.
reason: The flowers are yellow with orange stripes, not orange.
'no scent' after the flower description: flower not odorous. The OCR columns are interleaved, but every adjacent taxon says the same.
Racemes densely many-flowered: flowers present, many, within the inflorescence.

fix: A heading 'Male flowers:' / 'Female flowers:' sets the state slot for every following statement until the next heading.
